title: Polio Vaccination Campaign

headings.text: Kare kowane yaro ɗan ƙasa da shekara biyar
Abin da iyaye ya kamata su sani

key_sentences: All children under five years old will receive polio vaccine drops free of charge.
Vaccinate your child again even if he or she has been vaccinated before.
Health workers will visit every house from Saturday to Tuesday.
After vaccination, the child's little finger will be marked with ink.
Za a ba duk yara 'yan ƙasa da shekara biyar digon maganin rigakafin cutar shan inna kyauta.
Ku sake kawo ɗanku a yi masa rigakafi ko da an taɓa yi masa a baya.
Ma'aikatan lafiya za su ziyarci kowane gida daga ranar Asabar zuwa ranar Talata.
Bayan an yi wa yaro rigakafi, za a sanya masa alama da tawada a ɗan yatsansa.

rows: Kwaroro Primary Health Centre / Asibitin Kwaroro
Central market, east gate / Babbar kasuwa, ƙofar gabas
Dan Kade primary school / Makarantar firamare ta Dan Kade

list_items.text: Keep your child's vaccination card and show it to the team.
A child who is sick can still be vaccinated.
Tell the team if a child in the house was not vaccinated.
Ku ajiye katin rigakafin ɗanku kuma ku nuna wa ma'aikata.
Yaro mara lafiya ma ana iya yi masa rigakafi.
Ku sanar da ma'aikata idan akwai yaron da ba a yi wa rigakafi ba a gidan.

furniture: Kwaroro District Health Office · Ofishin Kiwon Lafiya na Gundumar Kwaroro
notes: Bilingual leaflet: the English column (left) and its Hausa translation (right) are PARALLEL side-by-side boxes; reading order is the whole English box, then the whole Hausa box, then the schedule. Hausa uses the hooked letters ɗ, ƙ and the apostrophe in 'yan and Ma'aikatan. The banner date line is body text. The schedule table has bilingual cells 'English / Hausa' (kept as one cell text) and zebra rows.
